1.texto_original: Sa aba mo na sumasamsam, at ikaw ay hindi nasamsaman; at gumagawa na may kataksilan, at sila'y hindi gumawang may kataksilan sa iyo! Pagka ikaw ay naglikat ng pagsamsam, ikaw ay sasamsaman; at pagka ikaw ay nakatapos ng paggawang may kataksilan, sila'y gagawang may kataksilan sa iyo.
1.normal:
Devotional Study of Isaias 33:1

"Sa aba mo na sumasamsam, at ikaw ay hindi nasamsaman; at gumagawa na may kataksilan, at sila'y hindi gumawang may kataksilan sa iyo! Pagka ikaw ay naglikat ng pagsamsam, ikaw ay sasamsaman; at pagka ikaw ay nakatapos ng paggawang may kataksilan, sila'y gagawang may kataksilan sa iyo."

This verse carries deep theological significance. The original Hebrew/Greek text reveals layers of meaning that illuminate Gods character and purposes. The context within the broader narrative provides essential framework for understanding.

The historical backdrop adds richness to interpretation. Archaeological discoveries continue to confirm and illuminate the cultural setting in which these words were written.

For the modern reader, this verse offers both comfort and challenge. It invites us to trust in Gods sovereign plan while actively living out its principles in daily life.
